description: Single Cartesian plot area with overlaid point markers and a connecting polyline across the same space. Axes/gridlines/labels ignored.

components.description: A dense set of semi-transparent circular markers scattered across the plotting region, visually forming vertical clusters at several x positions; all markers share similar size.
A single thick polyline traversing the plot, connecting several key x positions with straight segments; overall up-then-down-then-flat-slight-up shape across the width.

primary.explanation: Scatter of similarly sized points across x and y; approximate total count of markers.

secondary.explanation: Scatter of similarly sized points across x and y; approximate total count of markers.

primary.explanation: Single polyline (one series) laid out along the horizontal axis.

secondary.explanation: Seven control points across key x positions (years).
